༄༅/ /rdo rje khyung khra'i dbang sgrub thabs las phran dang bcas pa jo bo nā ro pa'i lugs

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje khyung khra'i dbang sgrub thabs las phran dang bcas pa jo bo nā ro pa'i lugs

bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī kā la tsakra ga ru ḍā ya/ rdo rje khyung khra 'di la/ brgyud rim/ sgrub thabs/ dbang bskur/ las phran no/ dang po brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*| ye shes mkha' 'gro/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ rin 'od/ grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon dpal/ nam grags pa/ bsod rgyan/ gzungs dpal| ā nanta pa/ sa bzang*/ bsam rtse ba/ chos 'phel/ nam bsod pa/ dpal 'byor/ chos dbang rin chen/ bla ma dā na sampāt+s+manna/ des bdag chos kyi grags pa la'o/// / ༈ /gnyis pa/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i khyung khra'i sgrub thabs ni/ gnas dben par khyung khra'i bris sku'i mdun du dkar gtor/ bdud rtsi/ mchod pa rnams bshams/ stan bde bar 'dug ste/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgoms/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni spyi 'gro ltar bya/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du rang rig khroṃ dang kṣiṃ 'od 'bar ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo la rnam pa rdo rje bya khyung zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ brla byin sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ lto ba chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ stod me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal nam mkha'i rang bzhin nag po/ spyi bo rlung gi rang bzhin ljang gu/ gshog pa gnyis kyi rgyab nag po/ mdun dkar po/ bar dmar po/ phrag gong dang rgyab tu sprin dmar nag 'khrugs pa/ mjug ma ye shes kyi rang bzhin sngon po/ phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub kyis klu thams cad tshar gcod pa/ g.yon snying khar skyabs sbyin gyis rjes su 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dmar zlum khro gnyer g.yo zhing smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ gnam lcags rdo rje pha lam gyi mchu sder dang rwa gnyis gdengs pa/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ klu'i rgyal po'i spyi gtsug nas 'phrog pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rwa sprag tu brgyan pa/

zhabs gnyis tsog pus klu rigs lnga mnan pa/ mdun du buddha rigs kyi khyung ser po/ g.yas su ratna rigs kyi khyung dmar po/ rgyab tu padma'i rigs kyi khyung dkar po/ g.yon du karma'i rigs kyi khyung ljang gu rnams 'phur stabs can/ thams cad kyang sku ri rab ltar che ba/ 'od zer bskal me ltar 'bar ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pratītstsha swā hā/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma las/ mi bskyod pa sprul skus rgyas btab par gyur/ dbang lha rang la bstim/ oṃ pakṣiṃ ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ kṣiṃ las byung ba'i 'dab chags mgon po ni// 'byung ba'i mdog can 'byung chen bzhi la dbang*// klu rigs bzhi 'dul rdo rje'i gshog par ldan// gnam lcags 'bar ba rdo rje'i rwa mchu can// sder mo ldan pas sa bdag gnyan 'joms pa// kun tu rgyu byed rdo rje'i gshog sgra ldan// klu yi dpal 'phrog lha yi dpal gyur pa| |rdo rje khyung khra'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ rang gi snying khar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar rdo rje'i khyung rang 'dra'i thugs kar kṣiṃ nag po/ mdun du buddha'i khyung ser po g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa'i thugs kar oṃ ser po/ g.yas su ratna'i khyung dmar po g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa'i thugs kar pa dmar po/ rgyab tu padma'i khyung dkar po g.yas padma dkar po 'dzin pa'i thugs kar swā ser po/

g.yon du las kyi khyung ljang gu g.yas ral gri thogs pa'i thugs kar hā ljang gu/ thams cad g.yon skyabs sbyin can rwa dang mchu sder 'bar ba sa bon rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams mchod cing de dag gi byin rlabs dang mthu stobs bsdus nas rang la bstims/ klu gnyan sa bdag ma rungs pa rnams tshar bcad/ snying rje'i rjes su bzung nas rdo rje khyung khra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas rtags ma mthong na 'bum phrag lnga bzla'o// 'khor so so'i thugs kar khroṃ re re bsams nas/ oṃ buddha ratna padma karma ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces khri phrag gcig bzla'o// de dag ni bsnyen pa'o// thugs ka'i sngags khyung rnams mgrin par spos nas/ dmigs pa snga ma lta bus gtso bo'i sngags rnams 'bum phrag gcig gam rtags ma byung na 'bum phrag gsum bzlas la 'khor la stong phrag lnga bzla'o// 'di ni sgrub pa'o// bsnyen sgrub gnyis kar rtags ni rmi lam du/ mgo la nyi zla shar ba dang*// me tog sna tshogs 'thu ba dang*// rgya mtshor rkang lag rkyong ba dang*// sbal lcong zos pa la sogs rmi// dngos su sa g.yo ba dang*/ khang par tshag sgra dang*/ lus la me 'bar ba sogs 'byung ngo*// thun mtshams su spyi 'gro ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ badzra ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ pakṣiṃ ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pa bdun dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ mchod bstod sngar ltar bya/ yig brgya bzla/ gtor mgron ye shes pa gshegs| dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ mjug bsngo bas rgyas gdab/ bskyed rdzogs dbyer med du nyams su blang ngo*/// /

༈ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ tshom bu'i steng du lnga tshan lngas gang ba'i bum pa bkod/ bris sku/ dpal gtor/ me long*/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā bris pa/ rdo rje/ bdud rtsi/ rdor dril sogs 'du bya/ bum pa dang mdun bskyed gong ltar gsal btab/ mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ bdag 'jug blangs/ slob ma khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ gral la 'khod/ maṇḍal phul nas| kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dbus su don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga par bsam/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ zhes brjod la/ bla mas rdo rje me tog slob ma'i snying khar bzhag nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ slob ma khyung khrar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ snying khar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ gnas gsum du dri'i thig le bya zhing*| oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod/ tsakṣuḥbhandha wā ra mā na yes gdong bcings/ a khaṃ bī ras me tog gtad/ gsang ba'i gdams rdzas ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa'i tshul 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya zhing*/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes so// phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni rdo rje mgor bzhag /ngas khyod la rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang 'dis 'grub na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ de bas gsang ba 'di gzhan la smra bar mi bya'o// nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje snying khar reg ste/ de ring rdo rje khyung khra ni// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu khyod nyams so// zhes so// gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/

thod pa'i bdud rtsi khar byin la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu// 'thungs shig nyams na dmyal bar ltung*// bsrung na dngos grub thams cad 'grub// de bas rdo rje'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ badzra sa ma ya u da ka ṭha hūm̐/ zhes so// slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ khyod kyi rdo rje khyung khra nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di khyod kyis gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par byed na khyod ya nga ba ma spang bar shi ba'i dus byas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes bsgrags so// ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob mas/ bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi// thugs sprul byin rlabs mgon po mchog /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can// bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma khyung khra gtso rkyang du bskyed pa'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum dang*/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed khyung khra'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo rdo rje khyung khra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dpon slob gnyis kas/ slob ma la thim par bsam/ oṃ pakṣiṃ ga ru ḍa dzñā na kro dha ā we sha ya st+waṃ bha ra ra ra/ zhes dbab/ tiṣṭha badzra dang rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ me tog thogs nas lha'i rigs kyi rim pa ni/ bsod nams gang yin de dang sprod/ badzra puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes dor/ hoḥ rdo rje khyung khra deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje mig ni bla med pa'o// oṃ ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ mig dar bsal/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// dam tshig rnams ni skyong ba dang*// sngags rnams la ni brtson par mdzod// dbus su rdo rje khyung khra/

shar du buddha'i khyung ser po/ lhor ratna'i khyung dmar po/ nub tu padma'i khyung dkar po/ byang du las kyi khyung ljang gu rnams mthong ba ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bo yin pas dang po'i sangs rgyas mngon sum du mthong ba yin no// zhes brda sbyar ro// dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ sku'i dbang gi don du slob mas/ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra ni// sku mchog 'bar ba 'od zer can// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*// sku yi dbang bskur stsal du gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bum pa slob ma'i mgor bzhag |hoḥ lus la rdo rje khyung dbang bskur// bu khyod gdon bgegs las grol nas// srog bcad sdig pa dag gyur te// me long ye shes dbang thob shog /oṃ pakṣiṃ ga ru ḍa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dang bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sku'i bdud rtsis spyi bo'i 'khor lo gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// gsung dbang gi don du/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra ni// gsung mchog 'bar ba nga ro can// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed pa// bcom ldan gsung gi dbang bskur stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bum pa mgrin par bzhag la/ hoḥ ngag la rdo rje khyung dbang bskur// bu khyod gdon bgegs las grol nas// ngag 'chal sgrib pa dag gyur te// sor rtogs ye shes dbang thob shog /oṃ wā ka ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar dbang bskur bas/ gsung gi bdud rtsi dmar pos mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang*/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rtsa rlung thig le bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skal ldan du byas so| |thugs dbang gi don du/ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra ni// thugs mchog 'bar ba spros dang bral// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed pa// bcom ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol//

gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bum pa snying khar bzhag /hoḥ yid la rdo rje khyung dbang bskur// bu khyod gdon bgegs las grol nas// ma rig yid sgrib dag gyur te// chos dbyings ye shes spros dang bral// oṃ tsitta ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar dbang bskur bas/ thugs kyi bdud rtsi sngon pos snying kha'i 'khor lo gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gyi pho nya'i lam la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// tshig dbang gi don du/ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra ni/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag |gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms byed pa// bcom ldan don gyi dbang bskur stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ me long bstan la/ hoḥ snang srid thams cad phyag rgya che// spros kun gsal stong khyab gdal che// gang gis 'di nyid mthong rtogs pa// bsam du med pa'i dbang bskur ro// sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ de ltar dbang bskur bas/ don gyi bdud rtsis lus sems thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum der 'dzin gyi dri ma dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ rdor dril slob ma'i g.yas g.yon du gtad la/ hoḥ thabs shes rdo rje dril bu che// zungs shig bcu drug gzhon nu mar// 'khyud pa bdag po'i dbang yin te// slob ma bsdu sogs las sgrubs shig /badzra ghaṇṭa badzra pa ti hūm̐/ de ltar dbang bskur bas/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i bya bar 'os pa rdo rje khyung khra bsgrubs shing dbang bskur ba dang las la sbyar ba/ thogs med du bgyi ba la dbang bar byas so// rjes gnang ni/ sku tsaka li dang*/ gsung snying po 'bru lnga bris pa dang*/ thugs rdo rje slob ma'i dpral mgrin snying khar reg cing*/

hoḥ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang*// lus ngag yid la dbang bskur bas// phrin las mthar phyin rdzogs par shog /kā ya wā ka tsitta siddhi pha la hūm̐/ des sku gsung thugs kyi las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// sngags dbang ni/ slob mas/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// gsum gsol| slob dpon dang mdun bskyed khyung khra'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng gser btso ma lta bu spros pa zhal nas thon/ slob ma khyung khrar gsal ba'i rna ba gnyis nas zhugs/ thugs kar 'khor bar bsam 'bru lnga'i sngags kyi rjes zlos brgya phrag bya/ mthar slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ bla mas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog dor/ rjes gnang bka' gtad ni/ dpal gtor khyung khrar gsal ba slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ hoḥ bcom ldan rdo rje khyung khra ni// 'di la 'go zhing grogs mdzod la// don gyi srung ma mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ rdo rje 'chang ye shes mkha' 'gro nas/ bla ma dā na sampānna la sogs rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung khra dus kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bor bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis slob ma 'di dus deng nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'go zhing sdong grogs mdzad pa dang*/ srung ba dang skyob pa dang dbang bskur ba dang nad gdon bar gcod thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ pakṣiṃ ga ru ḍa sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes mgor bzhag gtor ma nas dngos grub re zar bcug /bdud rtsi sbyin/

rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ dam tshig bsrung ba khas blangs/ bum mdun gyi lha la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bkra shis/ bsngo smon sogs bya'o// 'di ni dbang rgyas pa'i lugs yin la bsdus na sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang ltar bskur bas kyang dgos pa 'grub bo/// / ༈ /bzhi pa las phran byab khrus byed na/ bca' gzhi gzhan sngar ltar la/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs skyon med la sngags brgya phrag btab la bzhag /dbang bzhi pa me long gis bskur ba'i mjug der bum chus bkru zhing khrus chu ngar glud kyi steng du bzed la/ rtsa sngags mthar/ nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ gdon thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ bgegs thams cadashāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ log 'dren thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ steng gdon gza' dang sgyu skar thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ bar gdon btsan dang the'u rang thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sha za smyo byed 'byung po thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ rgyal bsen sde brgyad dregs pa grib dang mi gtsang nad gdon thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mkhon dang gna' zos nyes sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bkru/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs kyi dbus su lha sngags gsal bas byab par bsam zhing*/ gong gi sham bu'i mtha'i shāntiṃ ku ru'i mal du a pa na ye sbyar bas byab/ ngar glud 'dre lnga'am bdud gcod kyi phyogs su bskyal/ yang sngar bshad pa'i sngags 'bru lnga po la 'bad nas rtags ma byung na/ oṃ pakṣiṃ rā dza na mo badzra ga ru ḍa e ba sarba nā ga sarba bi nā sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes so/ */bsnyen pa rgyas par byed na/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ zhes pa sku'i snying pa'o/ */oṃkṣiṃ swā hā/ gsung gi'o/ */

kṣiṃ pa oṃ swā hā/ thugs kyi'o// swā kṣiṃ pa oṃ hā/ yon tan gyi'o// hā swā kṣiṃ pa oṃ/ phrin las kyi'o// 'di rnams re re la 'bum phrag re bya'o// sgrub pa sngar ltar ro// yang dngul chu lag mthil g.yon par blug /g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga khyung lngar bsgoms khyung gis dug bsad nas zos par bsam/ oṃ pakṣiṃ swā hā/ nan gyis sod/ ces bzlas nas mchil ma btab la mnyes te zhig na sman la bsre'am bza'/ yang btsan dug la gong bzhin btab nas kyang za'o// 'di gnyis gang rung nad med kyis zos na bcud len gyi mchog go// yang bya khyung lnga'i ril bu la lha bskyed sngags btab nas zos na nad gdon thams cad 'joms so// yang na yungs kar gri thal bye ma gsum la sngags btab pa ser ba yong nges su gtor/ sor mo lnga khyung lngar bskyed/ mdzub ris byas pas 'chad cing yul gzhan du 'gro'o// yang dug sbrul dang khyi smyon sogs gcan gzan gyis rmugs pa'i rma rang gi dri chus bkrus sngags btab/ sor mo lnga khyung du bsam/ khyung gi mche bas dug zos par bsam/ sor mos byab pas phan no// yang rgya tshwa rgyam tshwa kha ru tshwa lan tshwa rnams la sngags btab nas btang bas srin nad ma zhu ba sel lo// yang sug smel/ sman dkar/ a ru ra/ bse ru dkar po bzhi la sngags btab pa'i phye ma btang bas dug nad thams cad sel lo// yang a ru ra dang brag zhun la sngags btab pa'i phye mas nad thams cad la phan/ tsha ba la de'i steng ga pur dang cu gang*/ grang ba la shing kun dang pi pi ling bsnan no// gzhan yang nad dang gdon thams cad la sngags dang ting 'dzin la 'dir sbyar bas mi phan mi srid do// dus snyigs ma'i tshe sa bdag klu gnyan gyi gnod 'tshe mang ba'i phyir 'di nyid kho na yi dam du bsngags so// gza' mdze gso ba sogs las phran gzhan rnams mang bar 'dug kyang ma bris so// zhes pa 'di'ang rang nyid nyams su blang ba'i phyir/

khyung khra'i sgrub thabs rang bzo'i rtog brtags la zab mor rtsi ba dag mthong ba dor nas/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs mngon rtogs dbang byab khrus dang bcas pa grub chen nā ro pa'i rgya gzhung nyid gtsor byas te/ 'khyer bde bar bkod pa ni/ 'bri gung rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas me glang zla ba lnga pa'i nyer gcig la gdan sa chen po 'bri gung du sbyar bas sems can thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /maṅga laṃ//
